end.summary:
Practised plant-eaters, meat-eaters, and animals that eat both.
Built food chains using arrows, including aam ka patta → illi and algae → larvae → machhli.
Explained that energy moves from the leaf to the caterpillar.
Predicted effects of removing a living thing from a food chain.
end.parentNote: Asha practised animal diets, food-chain arrows, and what happens when one part of a chain is removed. Manav clearly used arrows and explained the direction of energy in a chain. At home, ask them to make one food chain and say what might happen if one part is removed.
